eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: Estimate converting a dollar limit to a percent of the 2026 poverty guideline. Reference household: family of three with one caretaker (one parent, two children), HHSC Maximum Monthly Income Limit $188 a month. 188 * 12 / 27320 * 100 = 8.26, floored. Same formula for other published sizes with one caretaker: family of 1 with one caretaker: $78 a month = 5 percent (guideline $15,960); family of 2 with one caretaker: $163 a month = 9 percent (guideline $21,640); family of 4 with one caretaker: $226 a month = 8 percent (guideline $33,000); family of 5 with one caretaker: $251 a month = 7 percent (guideline $38,680). TANF actually tests dollar budgetary and recognizable needs, so this percent is a rough index only.

estimate.represents: Maximum monthly income at which a family of three with one caretaker can still get TANF cash help ($188), as a percent of the 2026 poverty guideline for three people.
